seas_and_oceans.description: The major bodies of water that separate the continents.

list.name: Berserk Sea
list.description: A sea known for its constant storms, thunder, and chaotic magnetic fields, making it extremely dangerous and cutting off the Northern and Southern Continents.

list.name: Sonia Sea
list.description: The major sea separating the Northern and Southern Continents. It is plagued by sea monsters, pirate fleets, and supernatural phenomena. It contains the Rorsted Archipelago.

list.name: Fog Sea
list.description: A sea located to the west of the continents, rumored to lead to the Western Continent. It is the site of the first colonies of the Intis Republic.
